# `fintech_no_overdraft_beyond_credit_limit`

> No account may end the day with a net outflow larger than its credit limit.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [fintech](README.md) |
| Layer | **gold** — evaluated by the `gold` gate |
| Model | `gld_fintech__account_daily_positions` (`fintech_gold_staging.gld_fintech__account_daily_positions`) |
| Check | `expression_is_true` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/fintech/gold/_gold.yml](../../../dbt/models/fintech/gold/_gold.yml) |

## What it checks

Every row satisfies `net_flow >= -credit_limit`.

## When it fails

The `gold` task of `medallion_fintech` fails, `publish_gold` doesn't run, and the batch is never added to `fintech_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.fintech_no_overdraft_beyond_credit_limit`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`overdraft_beyond_limit`**: withdrawal that pushes an account past its credit limit.

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=fintech SCENARIO=overdraft_beyond_limit BATCH=2026-10-20_overdraft_beyond_limit
make pipeline DOMAIN=fintech BATCH=2026-10-20_overdraft_beyond_limit
```
